display.title: Nether Wart Warranty

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
Nether Wart Warranty is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: That will brew into more than medicine. It will brew into confidence. Take your reward.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: The notes also require one Blaze Rod.
missing_proof: Bring Nether Wart. The whole request is written around it.
missing_target: Nether Wart without the fortress route is a guess. I need the place confirmed.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: My brewing notes have a hole shaped exactly like Nether Wart. I hate how often that happens.
There is medicine I cannot make without an ugly trip. A fortress should have what we need.

responses.label: I will go to the Nether

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}. Nether Wart is the cure; a Blaze Rod proves you reached the heat of it.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: Nether Wart Warranty is already settled.
locate_failed: I cannot read a fortress route from here. The Nether is being unusually honest about being hostile.
started: The fortress mark sits {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod.
unavailable: This request needs steadier hands than you have shown me so far.

lines: If you smell like smoke and bad decisions, I hope you also brought supplies.
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
